productArea.name: Settings and data model
productArea.scope: Manage profile, workspace, members and roles, domains, AI, and API settings, and edit objects, fields, and navigation layout in the data model. Record lists and record pages are checked only where a settings change shows up; their own behavior is outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Settings then Data model to create, edit, and delete objects and fields.
Choose Settings then Layout to edit navigation folders and record actions.
Choose Settings then Members to manage members and roles.
Choose Settings then AI to manage skills and workspace instructions.
Choose Settings then General for workspace settings, including domains.
Choose Settings then Profile to edit the profile and its picture.
